scripts.api:ko: node ../buildScripts/syncShaderDoc.js && cross-env DOC_LANG=ko npx typedoc --options typedoc.config.js && node ../buildScripts/github/filterLanguageFiles.js ko
scripts.api:en: node ../buildScripts/syncShaderDoc.js && cross-env DOC_LANG=en npx typedoc --options typedoc.config.js && node ../buildScripts/github/filterLanguageFiles.js en
scripts.api:all: npm run api:ko && npm run api:en
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run api:all && vitepress build && node ../buildScripts/github/deploy-manual.js
